newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP has 32 MMscfd offshore gas flow.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP has 32 MMscfd offshore gas flow.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Thursday the Scarborough-2 well offshore Western Australia flowed gas at the rate of 32 million standard cubic feet per day (MMscfd) for 19 hours during a production test.
The flow was through a 56/64-inch choke over the interval 1,922-1,931 metres, BHP said in its weekly drilling report.
A maximum flow rate of 42.3 MMscfd, limited by the capacity of the test equipment, was subsequently sustained for fours hours, it said.
The well is in the Exmouth Plateau permit WA-1-R, in which BHP and an Exxon Corp unit are 50/50 partners.
BHP said that earlier on Thursday, preparations were being made to run a production test string for a production test over a second interval.
The well is at a depth of 2,068 metres.
